more_gun.ponder.sentry.text_1: This is a Building Box containing a Sentry
more_gun.ponder.sentry.text_2: Hit it with a Wrench to deploy it
more_gun.ponder.sentry.text_3: Once deployed, It will scan for targets in a 20 block radius
more_gun.ponder.sentry.text_4: You can pick it up by right clicking it while sneaking with an empty hand
